q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा अनुच्छेद 21A जोड़कर भारत में निःशुल्क एवं अनिवार्य प्रारंभिक शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार बनाया गया?
e: The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A in Part III, guaranteeing free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 years. (86वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2002 ने भाग III में अनुच्छेद 21A जोड़कर 6 से 14 वर्ष के बच्चों के लिए निःशुल्क एवं अनिवार्य शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार बनाया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) 86th Amendment also modified Article 45 (DPSP) for ECCE below age 6; (2) It added the 11th Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(k); (3) Article 21A came into force on 1 April 2010 along with the RTE Act, 2009; (4) It was based on the Tapas Majumdar Committee (1999) recommendations.
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act inserted Article 21A to make free and compulsory elementary education a Fundamental Right in India?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा 'शिक्षा' विषय को राज्य सूची से समवर्ती सूची (प्रविष्टि 25) में स्थानांतरित किया गया?
e: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 (often called the 'Mini-Constitution') moved 'Education' from Entry 11 of the State List to Entry 25 of the Concurrent List in the Seventh Schedule. (42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 द्वारा शिक्षा को राज्य सूची की प्रविष्टि 11 से हटाकर सातवीं अनुसूची की समवर्ती सूची की प्रविष्टि 25 में रखा गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Five subjects moved to the Concurrent List in 1976: Education, Forests, Weights & Measures, Protection of Wild Animals & Birds, and Administration of Justice; (2) Entry 66 of the Union List covers coordination and determination of standards in higher/technical education; (3) Swaran Singh Committee recommended the 42nd Amendment; (4) Both Parliament and State Legislatures can legislate on education, with Central law prevailing in case of conflict (Article 254).
qe: By which Constitutional Amendment was the subject 'Education' transferred from the State List to the Concurrent List (Entry 25)?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद अल्पसंख्यकों को अपनी पसंद के शिक्षण संस्थान स्थापित करने और उनका प्रशासन करने का अधिकार देता है?
e: Article 30(1) grants all minorities, whether based on religion or language, the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice. (अनुच्छेद 30(1) धर्म या भाषा पर आधारित सभी अल्पसंख्यकों को अपनी पसंद के शिक्षण संस्थान स्थापित करने एवं उनका प्रशासन करने का अधिकार देता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Article 30(2) prohibits the State from discriminating against minority institutions in granting financial aid; (2) Article 29 protects the distinct language, script, or culture of any section of citizens and prohibits denial of admission in state-aided institutions on religion/race/caste/language; (3) TMA Pai Foundation Case (2002) defined minority status at the State level; (4) Minority educational institutions are exempted from RTE 25% quota per Pramati Educational Trust Case (2014).
qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice?

q: अनुच्छेद 51A के अंतर्गत कौन-सा मौलिक कर्तव्य माता-पिता या अभिभावक को 6 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के अपने बच्चे को शिक्षा के अवसर प्रदान करने का दायित्व सौंपता है?
e: Article 51A(k), the 11th Fundamental Duty, was added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002, obligating parents/guardians to provide educational opportunities to children aged 6–14 years. (86वें संशोधन अधिनियम, 2002 द्वारा जोड़ा गया 11वाँ मौलिक कर्तव्य अनुच्छेद 51A(k) माता-पिता को 6–14 वर्ष के बच्चों को शिक्षा का अवसर देने का कर्तव्य सौंपता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Originally 10 Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 in Part IVA; (2) Article 51A(h) calls for developing scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry; (3) Article 51A(j) calls for striving towards excellence in all spheres; (4) Fundamental Duties were inspired by the Constitution of the former USSR.
qe: Which Fundamental Duty under Article 51A makes it the duty of a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to their child aged between 6 and 14 years?

q: संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद प्रत्येक राज्य और स्थानीय प्राधिकारी को भाषाई अल्पसंख्यक वर्गों के बच्चों के लिए शिक्षा के प्राथमिक स्तर पर मातृभाषा में शिक्षण की पर्याप्त सुविधा प्रदान करने का निर्देश देता है?
e: Article 350A, inserted by the 7th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1956, directs every State and local authority to endeavour to provide adequate facilities for instruction in the mother-tongue at the primary stage for linguistic minorities. (7वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1956 द्वारा जोड़ा गया अनुच्छेद 350A प्राथमिक स्तर पर मातृभाषा में शिक्षा की सुविधा का निर्देश देता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Article 350B (also added by 7th Amendment, 1956) provides for a Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities appointed by the President; (2) Article 351 directs the Union to promote the spread and development of the Hindi language; (3) Article 343 declares Hindi in Devanagari script as the Official Language of the Union; (4) NEP 2020 strongly aligns with Article 350A by promoting mother-tongue instruction at least up to Grade 5.
qe: Which Article of the Constitution directs every State and local authority to provide adequate facilities for instruction in the mother-tongue at the primary stage of education to children belonging to linguistic minority groups?

q: किस ऐतिहासिक सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के निर्णय में 14 वर्ष की आयु तक के बच्चों के लिए शिक्षा के अधिकार को अनुच्छेद 21 (जीवन के अधिकार) से निःसृत एक निहित मौलिक अधिकार माना गया?
o: उन्नी कृष्णन बनाम आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य (1993)
e: In Unni Krishnan, J.P. vs. State of Andhra Pradesh (1993), a 5-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court held that every child has a Fundamental Right to free education under Article 21 until completing the age of 14 years. (उन्नी कृष्णन बनाम आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य (1993) के निर्णय में 5 न्यायाधीशों की संविधान पीठ ने 14 वर्ष तक निःशुल्क शिक्षा को अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत मौलिक अधिकार घोषित किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Earlier, in Mohini Jain vs. State of Karnataka (1992) — the 'Capitation Fee Case' — a 2-judge bench had declared right to education at all levels a fundamental right; (2) Unni Krishnan (1993) partially modified Mohini Jain by limiting the fundamental right to age 14, with higher education subject to State economic capacity; (3) Unni Krishnan directly paved the way for the 86th Amendment (2002); (4) T.M.A. Pai (2002) later reviewed the admission/fee scheme of Unni Krishnan.
qe: In which landmark Supreme Court judgment was the Right to Education first held to be an implicit Fundamental Right flowing from Article 21 (Right to Life) for children up to the age of 14 years?
oe: Unni Krishnan vs. State of Andhra Pradesh (1993)

q: 93वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2005 ने उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों के संबंध में भारतीय संविधान में क्या जोड़ा?
o: सहायता प्राप्त एवं गैर-सहायता प्राप्त निजी शिक्षण संस्थानों में आरक्षण हेतु अनुच्छेद 15(5)
e: The 93rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2005 inserted Article 15(5), enabling the State to make special provisions (including reservations) for SEBCs, SCs, and STs in admission to aided or unaided private educational institutions, excluding minority institutions under Article 30(1). (93वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2005 ने अनुच्छेद 15(5) जोड़ा, जो अल्पसंख्यक संस्थानों को छोड़कर अन्य सभी सहायता प्राप्त व गैर-सहायता प्राप्त निजी शिक्षण संस्थानों में SC/ST/OBC आरक्षण का प्रावधान करता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) It was enacted to overcome the P.A. Inamdar Case (2005) ruling; (2) Parliament subsequently passed the Central Educational Institutions (Reservation in Admission) Act, 2006 providing 27% OBC quota; (3) Its validity was upheld in Ashoka Kumar Thakur vs. Union of India (2008); (4) Later, the 103rd Amendment Act (2019) inserted Article 15(6) for 10% EWS reservation in educational institutions.
qe: What did the 93rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2005 insert into the Indian Constitution regarding higher educational institutions?
oe: Article 15(5) for reservation in aided and unaided private educational institutions

q: राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्वों का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद राज्य को अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों और अन्य दुर्बल वर्गों के शिक्षा एवं अर्थ संबंधी हितों की विशेष सावधानी से अभिवृद्धि करने का निर्देश देता है?
e: Article 46 in Part IV (DPSP) directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of weaker sections, particularly SCs and STs, and protect them from social injustice and exploitation. (भाग IV का अनुच्छेद 46 राज्य को SC, ST और अन्य दुर्बल वर्गों के शैक्षिक व आर्थिक हितों के विशेष संवर्धन का निर्देश देता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Article 41 deals with the right to work, education, and public assistance in certain cases; (2) Article 45 (post-86th Amendment) mandates early childhood care and education (ECCE) for children below 6 years; (3) Article 46 reflects Gandhian principles in the DPSP; (4) Scholarships, residential schools (Eklavya Model Residential Schools), and reservation policies derive constitutional backing from Article 46.
qe: Which Article of the Directive Principles of State Policy directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other weaker sections?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 28 के अंतर्गत किस प्रकार के शिक्षण संस्थान में धार्मिक शिक्षा पूर्णतः प्रतिबंधित है?
o: पूर्णतः राज्य निधि से पोषित संस्थान
राज्य द्वारा प्रशासित किंतु धार्मिक विन्यास के अधीन स्थापित संस्थान
राज्य निधि से सहायता प्राप्त संस्थान
e: Article 28(1) strictly prohibits any religious instruction in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds. (अनुच्छेद 28(1) पूर्णतः राज्य निधि से पोषित किसी भी शिक्षण संस्थान में धार्मिक शिक्षा पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध लगाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Article 28(2) exempts institutions administered by the State but established under an endowment/trust requiring religious instruction; (2) Article 28(3) states that in State-recognized or State-aided institutions, no person can be compelled to attend religious instruction/worship without consent (or guardian's consent if minor); (3) Article 28 upholds the secular character of Indian public education; (4) In Aruna Roy vs. Union of India (2002), the SC distinguished 'value-based study of religions' from 'religious instruction'.
qe: Under Article 28 of the Indian Constitution, religious instruction is COMPLETELY prohibited in which type of educational institution?
oe: Institutions wholly maintained out of State funds
Institutions administered by the State but established under a religious endowment
Institutions receiving aid out of State funds

q:
सूची-I (संवैधानिक अनुच्छेद) को सूची-II (शैक्षिक प्रावधान) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) अनुच्छेद 21A, (2) अनुच्छेद 45, (3) अनुच्छेद 350A, (4) अनुच्छेद 351
सूची-II: (a) 6 वर्ष से कम आयु हेतु प्रारंभिक देखभाल व शिक्षा, (b) हिंदी भाषा का विकास, (c) 6–14 वर्ष हेतु निःशुल्क व अनिवार्य शिक्षा, (d) प्राथमिक स्तर पर मातृभाषा
e: Article 21A covers free and compulsory education for 6–14 years (1-c); Article 45 covers ECCE for children below 6 years (2-a); Article 350A covers primary instruction in mother-tongue for linguistic minorities (3-d); Article 351 covers promotion of Hindi (4-b). (अनुच्छेद 21A-6 से 14 वर्ष शिक्षा, अनुच्छेद 45-6 वर्ष से कम ECCE, अनुच्छेद 350A-मातृभाषा शिक्षा, अनुच्छेद 351-हिंदी विकास; अतः 1-c, 2-a, 3-d, 4-b।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Before 2002, Article 45 originally called for free & compulsory education up to age 14 within 10 years of the Constitution's commencement; (2) Article 350A was inserted via the 7th Amendment Act, 1956; (3) Article 351 directs Hindi to draw vocabulary primarily from Sanskrit and secondarily from other Eighth Schedule languages; (4) Article 21A is justiciable, whereas Articles 45 and 351 are non-justiciable directives.
qe:
Match List-I (Constitutional Article) with List-II (Educational Provision) and choose the correct code:
List-I: (1) Article 21A, (2) Article 45, (3) Article 350A, (4) Article 351
List-II: (a) ECCE below age 6, (b) Promotion of Hindi language, (c) Free & compulsory education (6–14 yrs), (d) Mother-tongue at primary stage

q:
शिक्षा पर विधायी शक्तियों के संवैधानिक विभाजन (सातवीं अनुसूची) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: संघ सूची की प्रविष्टि 66 संसद को उच्च शिक्षा, अनुसंधान तथा वैज्ञानिक/तकनीकी संस्थानों के मानकों के समन्वय व निर्धारण की शक्ति देती है।
कथन II: समवर्ती सूची की प्रविष्टि 25 में तकनीकी, चिकित्सा शिक्षा और विश्वविद्यालयों सहित शिक्षा शामिल है, जो संघ सूची की प्रविष्टि 63, 64, 65 व 66 के अधीन है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
कथन I और कथन II दोनों
e: Both statements are completely accurate as per the Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution. (सातवीं अनुसूची के अनुसार दोनों कथन पूर्णतः सत्य हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Entry 63 of the Union List names BHU, AMU, and Delhi University as institutions of national importance; (2) Entry 64 covers scientific/technical institutions of national importance financed by the Government of India (like IITs); (3) Entry 65 covers Union agencies for professional/vocational training and research; (4) UGC Act 1956 and AICTE Act 1987 were enacted by Parliament under Entry 66 of the Union List.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the constitutional distribution of legislative powers over education (Seventh Schedule):
Statement I: Entry 66 of the Union List empowers Parliament to coordinate and determine standards in institutions for higher education, research, and scientific/technical institutions.
Statement II: Entry 25 of the Concurrent List covers education including technical, medical education, and universities, subject to Entries 63, 64, 65, and 66 of the Union List.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: 86वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2002 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: इसने संविधान के भाग III में अनुच्छेद 21A जोड़ा
इसने संविधान के भाग IV में अनुच्छेद 45 में संशोधन किया
इसने भाग IVA के अनुच्छेद 51A में नया खंड (k) जोड़ा
यह 12 दिसंबर 2002 को तत्काल विधिक रूप से लागू हो गया
e: Although the 86th Amendment Act received Presidential assent on 12 December 2002, it did NOT come into immediate force; the Central Government notified its commencement date as 1 April 2010 alongside the RTE Act, 2009. (यद्यपि राष्ट्रपति ने 12 दिसंबर 2002 को स्वीकृति दी, तथापि यह अधिनियम तत्काल लागू नहीं हुआ बल्कि RTE अधिनियम, 2009 के साथ 1 अप्रैल 2010 से प्रभावी हुआ।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) It was introduced as the 93rd Constitution Amendment Bill, 2001 before being enacted as the 86th Amendment Act, 2002; (2) It is the only amendment to simultaneously alter Fundamental Rights (Part III), DPSP (Part IV), and Fundamental Duties (Part IVA); (3) India became one of ~135 countries to make education a fundamental right on 1 April 2010; (4) The 86th Amendment applies across India (extended to J&K after the 2019 Reorganisation Act).
qe: Which of the following statements about the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 is NOT correct?
oe: It inserted Article 21A in Part III of the Constitution
It amended Article 45 in Part IV of the Constitution
It added a new clause (k) to Article 51A in Part IVA
It came into immediate legal effect on 12 December 2002

q: निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 पूरे भारत में किस तिथि से लागू हुआ?
e: The RTE Act, 2009 was passed by Parliament on 4 August 2009, received Presidential assent on 26 August 2009, and came into legal force on 1 April 2010. (RTE अधिनियम, 2009 को 4 अगस्त 2009 को संसद ने पारित किया, 26 अगस्त 2009 को राष्ट्रपति की स्वीकृति मिली और 1 अप्रैल 2010 से यह लागू हुआ।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) The RTE Act contains 7 Chapters, 38 Sections, and 1 Schedule; (2) In Uttar Pradesh, the UP RTE Rules were notified on 27 July 2011; (3) Section 1 defines the short title, extent, and commencement; (4) Originally it exempted Jammu & Kashmir, which was removed after the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019.
qe: On which date did the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 come into force across India?

q: RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 12(1)(c) के अंतर्गत निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त गैर-अल्पसंख्यक विद्यालयों को प्रवेश स्तर पर कमजोर वर्ग एवं अलाभित समूह के बच्चों के लिए कितने प्रतिशत सीटें आरक्षित करनी होती हैं?
e: Section 12(1)(c) mandates that private unaided non-minority schools admit at least 25% of the strength of Class I (or pre-primary entry level) from children belonging to weaker sections and disadvantaged groups and provide them free education. (धारा 12(1)(c) के तहत निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त गैर-अल्पसंख्यक विद्यालयों में प्रवेश स्तर पर कम से कम 25% सीटें कमजोर व अलाभित वर्ग के बच्चों के लिए आरक्षित हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) The State Government reimburses per-child expenditure to private schools under Section 12(2); (2) In Society for Unaided Private Schools of Rajasthan vs. UOI (2012), SC upheld the 25% quota for non-minority unaided schools; (3) In Pramati Educational Trust (2014), SC exempted both aided and unaided minority schools from RTE; (4) Section 13 bans capitation fees (fine up to 10 times the fee) and screening procedures during admission.
qe: Under Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act, 2009, private unaided non-minority schools are required to reserve what percentage of seats at the entry level for children belonging to weaker sections and disadvantaged groups?

q: RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की अनुसूची के अनुसार, 120 विद्यार्थियों तक प्राथमिक कक्षाओं (कक्षा I से V) के लिए निर्धारित मानक छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात (PTR) क्या है?
e: The Schedule of the RTE Act prescribes a Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) of 30 : 1 for primary classes (I–V) and 35 : 1 for upper primary classes (VI–VIII). (RTE अधिनियम की अनुसूची के अनुसार प्राथमिक स्तर (कक्षा 1–5) पर मानक छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात 30 : 1 तथा उच्च प्राथमिक स्तर (कक्षा 6–8) पर 35 : 1 है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) For Classes I–V: up to 60 students = 2 teachers; 61–90 = 3 teachers; 91–120 = 4 teachers; 121–200 = 5 teachers; (2) Above 150 students in primary, 5 teachers + 1 Head Teacher are required; above 200 students, PTR (excluding Head Teacher) shall not exceed 40 : 1; (3) For Classes VI–VIII: at least 1 teacher each for Science & Maths, Social Studies, and Languages; (4) Section 25 mandates maintaining the prescribed PTR in every school.
qe: According to the Schedule of the RTE Act, 2009, what is the standard Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) prescribed for primary classes (Classes I to V) up to 120 students?

q: RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की कौन-सी धारा विद्यालयों में बच्चों को शारीरिक दंड और मानसिक उत्पीड़न से स्पष्ट रूप से प्रतिबंधित करती है?
e: Section 17(1) states that "No child shall be subjected to physical punishment or mental harassment", and Section 17(2) prescribes disciplinary action under service rules for anyone violating this prohibition. (धारा 17(1) विद्यालय में किसी भी बच्चे को शारीरिक दंड या मानसिक प्रताड़ना देने पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध लगाती है और उल्लंघन पर अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई का प्रावधान करती है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Section 13 prohibits capitation fee and screening procedures for admission; (2) Section 14 states no child shall be denied admission for lack of age proof; (3) Section 16 deals with examination and holding back (amended in 2019); (4) Section 28 prohibits private tuition by school teachers.
qe: Which section of the RTE Act, 2009 explicitly prohibits physical (corporal) punishment and mental harassment of children in schools?

q: RTE अधिनियम, 2009 (अनुसूची) के अंतर्गत उच्च प्राथमिक कक्षाओं (कक्षा VI से VIII) के लिए प्रति शैक्षणिक वर्ष न्यूनतम कितने कार्य दिवस और शिक्षण घंटे निर्धारित हैं?
e: The Schedule of the RTE Act prescribes a minimum of 220 working days and 1,000 instructional hours per academic year for Classes VI–VIII (Upper Primary), and 200 working days and 800 instructional hours for Classes I–V (Primary). (RTE अनुसूची के अनुसार उच्च प्राथमिक (कक्षा 6–8) के लिए 220 कार्य दिवस एवं 1000 शिक्षण घंटे तथा प्राथमिक (कक्षा 1–5) के लिए 200 कार्य दिवस एवं 800 शिक्षण घंटे अनिवार्य हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Minimum working hours per week for a teacher (including preparation hours) = 45 hours; (2) Section 27 prohibits deploying teachers for non-educational duties EXCEPT decennial census, disaster relief, and elections (local/state/parliament); (3) Every school must have a library, playground, barrier-free access, and separate toilets for boys and girls; (4) Section 19 sets norms and standards for school recognition.
qe: Under the RTE Act, 2009 (Schedule), what is the minimum number of working days and instructional hours per academic year prescribed for Upper Primary classes (Classes VI to VIII)?

q: RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 21 के अंतर्गत विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) के कितने प्रतिशत सदस्य उसी विद्यालय में पढ़ने वाले बच्चों के माता-पिता या अभिभावक होने चाहिए?
e: Section 21(1) mandates that at least three-fourths (75%) of the members of the School Management Committee (SMC) shall be parents or guardians of children admitted in the school, and 50% of all members shall be women. (धारा 21(1) के अनुसार विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) के कम से कम तीन-चौथाई (75%) सदस्य अभिभावक होंगे और कुल सदस्यों में से 50% महिलाएँ होंगी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Section 22 assigns SMC the duty to prepare the School Development Plan (SDP); (2) SMC is mandatory for government and government-aided schools (not unaided private schools); (3) Proportionate representation must be given to parents of disadvantaged groups and weaker sections; (4) In UP, SMC typically has 15 members (11 parents + 4 ex-officio/local authority members).
qe: Under Section 21 of the RTE Act, 2009, what proportion of the members of a School Management Committee (SMC) must be parents or guardians of children studying in that school?

q: RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की कौन-सी धारा शिक्षकों को निजी ट्यूशन या निजी शिक्षण गतिविधि करने से प्रतिबंधित करती है?
e: Section 28 of the RTE Act, 2009 explicitly states: "No teacher shall engage himself or herself in private tuition or private teaching activity." (धारा 28 स्पष्ट रूप से किसी भी शिक्षक द्वारा निजी ट्यूशन या निजी शिक्षण गतिविधि करने पर प्रतिबंध लगाती है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Section 23 deals with qualifications for appointment and terms/conditions of service of teachers (prescribed by NCTE); (2) Section 24 lists duties of teachers (regularity, punctuality, timely syllabus completion, parent-teacher meetings); (3) Section 27 restricts non-educational duties of teachers; (4) Section 29 deals with curriculum and evaluation procedure (CCE).
qe: Which section of the RTE Act, 2009 prohibits teachers from engaging in private tuition or private teaching activity?

q: निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2019 ने RTE अधिनियम की धारा 16 में संशोधन किस उद्देश्य से किया?
o: निःशुल्क शिक्षा की आयु सीमा 14 से बढ़ाकर 18 वर्ष करने हेतु
कक्षा 5 और 8 में नियमित परीक्षाओं की अनुमति देकर अनिवार्य 'नो डिटेंशन नीति' समाप्त करने हेतु
निजी स्कूलों में EWS कोटा 25% से बढ़ाकर 35% करने हेतु
शिक्षकों के निजी ट्यूशन पर प्रतिबंध हटाने हेतु
e: The RTE (Amendment) Act, 2019 (passed in January 2019) amended Section 16 to scrap the strict 'No Detention Policy', introducing regular examinations at the end of Class 5 and Class 8, with a re-examination opportunity within 2 months before deciding on detention. (RTE संशोधन अधिनियम, 2019 ने धारा 16 में संशोधन कर अनिवार्य 'नो डिटेंशन नीति' समाप्त की और कक्षा 5 व 8 में नियमित परीक्षा तथा 2 माह में पुनः परीक्षा का प्रावधान किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Even after the 2019 amendment, Section 16(4) strictly prohibits EXPULSION of any child from school until completion of elementary education; (2) The Central Government later notified revised rules in December 2024 implementing detention in Class 5 and 8 for central schools (KVs, JNVs, Sainik Schools); (3) Earlier, the RTE (Amendment) Act, 2012 had explicitly included children with disabilities under 'disadvantaged groups'; (4) The RTE (Amendment) Act, 2017 extended the deadline for untrained in-service teachers to acquire minimum qualifications until 31 March 2019.
qe: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (Amendment) Act, 2019 amended Section 16 of the RTE Act to:
oe: Raise the age limit of free education from 14 to 18 years
Abolish the mandatory 'No Detention Policy' by allowing regular exams in Classes 5 and 8
Increase the EWS quota in private schools from 25% to 35%
Remove the ban on private tuition by teachers

q:
सूची-I (RTE अधिनियम 2009 की धारा) को सूची-II (प्रावधान) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) धारा 4, (2) धारा 13, (3) धारा 27, (4) धारा 31
सूची-II: (a) गैर-शैक्षणिक कार्यों पर रोक, (b) आयु-अनुरूप कक्षा में प्रवेश, (c) NCPCR/SCPCR द्वारा बाल अधिकार की निगरानी, (d) कैपिटेशन शुल्क व स्क्रीनिंग पर रोक
e: Section 4 provides special provisions for age-appropriate admission of out-of-school children (1-b); Section 13 prohibits capitation fees and screening (2-d); Section 27 prohibits deploying teachers for non-educational duties (3-a); Section 31 empowers NCPCR and SCPCRs to monitor the child's right to education (4-c). (धारा 4-आयु-अनुरूप प्रवेश, धारा 13-कैपिटेशन शुल्क पर रोक, धारा 27-गैर-शैक्षणिक कार्य पर रोक, धारा 31-NCPCR/SCPCR निगरानी; अतः 1-b, 2-d, 3-a, 4-c।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Section 5 guarantees the right to transfer to another school (TC cannot be withheld); (2) Section 6 mandates establishing neighbourhood schools within 3 years (1 km for primary, 3 km for upper primary under model rules); (3) Section 32 provides grievance redressal by local authority within 3 months; (4) Section 33 establishes the National Advisory Council (NAC) on RTE.
qe:
Match List-I (RTE Act 2009 Section) with List-II (Provision) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) Section 4, (2) Section 13, (3) Section 27, (4) Section 31
List-II: (a) Prohibition of non-educational duties, (b) Age-appropriate admission, (c) Monitoring of child's right by NCPCR/SCPCR, (d) No capitation fee or screening

q:
RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 27 के अंतर्गत शिक्षकों को निम्नलिखित में से किन गैर-शैक्षणिक कार्यों में लगाया जा सकता है?
1. दशकीय जनगणना
2. आपदा राहत कार्य
3. पल्स पोलियो टीकाकरण अभियान
4. स्थानीय प्राधिकारी, राज्य विधानमंडल या संसद के चुनाव संबंधी कार्य
e: Section 27 explicitly prohibits deploying teachers for ANY non-educational purpose except three specified duties: (1) decennial population census, (2) disaster relief duties, and (3) duties relating to elections to local authorities, State Legislatures, or Parliament. Pulse Polio drive is NOT permitted. (धारा 27 केवल तीन गैर-शैक्षणिक कार्यों—दशकीय जनगणना, आपदा राहत और चुनाव ड्यूटी—की अनुमति देती है; पल्स पोलियो अभियान इसमें शामिल नहीं है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) This restriction protects classroom teaching time (minimum 200/220 days); (2) Section 26 mandates that teacher vacancies in a school shall not exceed 10% of total sanctioned strength; (3) Section 7 provides for concurrent financial sharing between Central and State Governments; (4) Chapter IV (Sections 12 to 28) is the longest chapter of the RTE Act, covering responsibilities of schools and teachers.
qe:
Under Section 27 of the RTE Act, 2009, teachers may be deployed for which of the following non-educational duties?
1. Decennial population census
2. Disaster relief duties
3. Pulse Polio immunization drive
4. Duties relating to elections to Local Authority, State Legislatures, or Parliament

q: किस ब्रिटिश विधायी अधिनियम ने पहली बार ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी को भारत में साहित्य और विज्ञान के संवर्धन के लिए प्रतिवर्ष ₹1 लाख खर्च करने का निर्देश दिया?
e: Section 43 of the Charter Act of 1813 directed the East India Company to allocate not less than ₹1 lakh per year for the revival and improvement of literature and promotion of sciences among the inhabitants of British India. (चार्टर एक्ट, 1813 की धारा 43 ने पहली बार भारत में शिक्षा के लिए प्रतिवर्ष ₹1 लाख के वार्षिक अनुदान का प्रावधान किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) This ₹1 lakh grant sparked the famous 'Orientalist–Anglicist Controversy' (प्राच्य-पाश्चात्य विवाद); (2) The General Committee of Public Instruction (GCPI) was formed in 1823 to administer the grant; (3) Lord Macaulay's Minute (2 February 1835) resolved the controversy in favour of English education; (4) Governor-General Lord William Bentinck approved Macaulay's Minute on 7 March 1835 (Downward Filtration Theory).
qe: Which British legislative enactment for the first time directed the East India Company to set aside ₹1 lakh annually for the promotion of literature and sciences in India?

q: 1854 के किस ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज़ को लोकप्रिय रूप से "भारत में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का मैग्ना कार्टा" कहा जाता है?
e: Wood's Despatch of 19 July 1854, drafted by Sir Charles Wood (President of the Board of Control) during Lord Dalhousie's tenure, is called the "Magna Carta of English Education in India". (लॉर्ड डलहौजी के कार्यकाल में सर चार्ल्स वुड द्वारा तैयार 1854 के वुड डिस्पैच को "भारत में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का मैग्ना कार्टा" कहा जाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) It recommended establishing a Department of Public Instruction (DPI) in every province; (2) It proposed universities at Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras on the London University model (established in 1857); (3) It introduced the 'Grant-in-Aid' (सहायता अनुदान) system for private schools and rejected the Downward Filtration Theory; (4) It advocated English for higher education and vernacular languages for primary schooling, plus female and vocational education.
qe: Which historic document of 1854 is popularly hailed as the "Magna Carta of English Education in India"?

q: स्वतंत्र भारत के प्रथम शिक्षा आयोग—विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षा आयोग (1948–49)—के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: Appointed in November 1948, the University Education Commission (1948–49) was chaired by Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan and submitted its report in August 1949. (नवंबर 1948 में गठित विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षा आयोग के अध्यक्ष डॉ. सर्वपल्ली राधाकृष्णन थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) It recommended establishing the University Grants Commission (UGC) on the UK model; (2) It recommended setting up Rural Universities and making Education a Concurrent subject; (3) It suggested 180 working days per year (excluding exam days) in universities; (4) Dr. A.L. Mudaliar chaired the Secondary Education Commission (1952–53), while Dr. D.S. Kothari chaired the Education Commission (1964–66).
qe: Who was the Chairman of the first Education Commission of Independent India, the University Education Commission (1948–49)?

q: किस शिक्षा आयोग (1964–66) ने प्रसिद्ध वाक्य "भारत का भाग्य अब उसकी कक्षाओं में गढ़ा जा रहा है" दिया और 10+2+3 शिक्षा संरचना की सिफारिश की?
e: The Indian Education Commission (1964–66), chaired by Dr. Daulat Singh Kothari, titled its report "Education and National Development" and recommended the uniform 10+2+3 structure. (डॉ. दौलत सिंह कोठारी की अध्यक्षता वाले कोठारी आयोग (1964–66) ने "शिक्षा और राष्ट्रीय विकास" शीर्षक से रिपोर्ट दी और 10+2+3 संरचना की अनुशंसा की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) It was the first commission to comprehensively examine ALL stages of education from primary to university; (2) It recommended allocating 6% of National Income (GDP) to education; (3) It proposed the 'Common School System' (समान विद्यालय प्रणाली) and 'Neighbourhood Schools'; (4) Its recommendations led directly to India's first National Policy on Education (NPE), 1968.
qe: Which Education Commission (1964–66) gave the famous opening line "The destiny of India is now being shaped in her classrooms" and recommended the 10+2+3 educational structure?

q: 1917–19 के किस आयोग ने, जिसे मुख्यतः कलकत्ता विश्वविद्यालय की समस्याओं के अध्ययन हेतु नियुक्त किया गया था, सर्वप्रथम इंटरमीडिएट कक्षाओं को विश्वविद्यालयों से अलग करने और माध्यमिक एवं इंटरमीडिएट शिक्षा बोर्ड स्थापित करने की सिफारिश की?
e: The Calcutta University Commission (1917–19), chaired by Sir Michael Sadler, recommended a 12-year school course followed by a 3-year degree course and the creation of Boards of Secondary and Intermediate Education (leading to the UP Board in 1921). (सर माइकल सैडलर की अध्यक्षता वाले सैडलर आयोग (1917–19) ने 12 वर्षीय स्कूली शिक्षा, 3 वर्षीय स्नातक पाठ्यक्रम और माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड की सिफारिश की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Two Indian members on the Sadler Commission were Sir Ashutosh Mukherjee and Dr. Ziauddin Ahmad; (2) The UP Board of High School and Intermediate Education was established in Allahabad in 1921 based on Sadler's recommendations; (3) Raleigh Commission (1902) led to the Indian Universities Act, 1904 under Lord Curzon; (4) Hartog Committee (1929) highlighted 'Wastage and Stagnation' (अपव्यय एवं अवरोधन) in primary education.
qe: Which Commission of 1917–19, appointed primarily to study the problems of Calcutta University, first recommended separating the Intermediate classes (2 years) from Universities and establishing Boards of Secondary and Intermediate Education?

q: महात्मा गांधी के 'नई तालीम' दर्शन से प्रेरित वर्धा बुनियादी शिक्षा योजना (1937) का विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम किसकी अध्यक्षता में गठित समिति द्वारा तैयार किया गया था?
e: Following the All-India National Education Conference at Wardha (October 1937), a committee headed by Dr. Zakir Husain drafted the detailed scheme of Basic Education (Buniyadi Shiksha / Nai Talim). (अक्टूबर 1937 के वर्धा शिक्षा सम्मेलन के पश्चात् डॉ. ज़ाकिर हुसैन की अध्यक्षता वाली समिति ने बुनियादी शिक्षा का विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम तैयार किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Key features: Free & compulsory education for 7 years (ages 7–14), mother-tongue as medium, and craft-centred productive education (हस्तशिल्प केंद्रित शिक्षा); (2) Gandhi first outlined these ideas in his weekly journal 'Harijan'; (3) Earlier, Gopal Krishna Gokhale moved the Compulsory Elementary Education Bill in the Imperial Legislative Council in 1911 (rejected); (4) The Sargent Plan (1944) was the last pre-independence blueprint, aiming for universal free education (ages 6–14) over 40 years.
qe: The Wardha Scheme of Basic Education (1937), inspired by Mahatma Gandhi's philosophy of 'Nai Talim', was formulated into a detailed syllabus by a committee headed by:

q: डॉ. ए. लक्ष्मणस्वामी मुदालियर की अध्यक्षता वाले माध्यमिक शिक्षा आयोग (1952–53) ने निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी प्रमुख सिफारिश की थी?
o: बहुउद्देशीय विद्यालयों एवं 3 वर्षीय उच्चतर माध्यमिक प्रणाली की शुरुआत
e: The Mudaliar Commission (1952–53) focused exclusively on secondary education and recommended establishing Multipurpose Schools (बहुउद्देशीय विद्यालय) with diversified courses, a 3-year Higher Secondary stage, and vocationalization. (मुदालियर आयोग (1952–53) ने विविध पाठ्यक्रमों वाले बहुउद्देशीय विद्यालयों और 3 वर्षीय उच्चतर माध्यमिक शिक्षा की सिफारिश की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) It proposed the 11-year school structure (4/5 primary + 3 middle + 3 higher secondary) followed by a 3-year degree; (2) It recommended setting up State Advisory Boards of Education and Guidance Bureaus; (3) Navodaya Vidyalayas and Operation Blackboard were introduced under NPE 1986; (4) It also recommended cumulative record cards and objective-type tests for evaluation reform.
qe: The Secondary Education Commission (1952–53), headed by Dr. A. Lakshmanaswami Mudaliar, made which of the following signature recommendations?
oe: Introduction of Multipurpose Schools and 3-year Higher Secondary system

q: किस राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति ने प्राथमिक विद्यालयों के लिए 'ऑपरेशन ब्लैकबोर्ड' (1987) और प्रतिभाशाली ग्रामीण बच्चों के लिए 'नवोदय विद्यालयों' की शुरुआत की?
e: The National Policy on Education (NPE), 1986 (during PM Rajiv Gandhi's tenure) launched Operation Blackboard (to ensure minimum essential facilities in primary schools), Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, DIETs (District Institutes of Education and Training), and open universities. (राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति, 1986 ने ऑपरेशन ब्लैकबोर्ड, जवाहर नवोदय विद्यालय, डाइट (DIET) और मुक्त विश्वविद्यालयों की शुरुआत की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NPE 1986 was reviewed by the Acharya Ramamurti Committee (1990) and the Janardhana Reddy Committee (1992), resulting in the Programme of Action (POA), 1992; (2) Operation Blackboard initially guaranteed at least 2 classrooms, 2 teachers (one female), and essential teaching-learning material; (3) NPE 1986 also emphasized Autonomous Colleges and the National System of Education (10+2+3); (4) District Primary Education Programme (DPEP, 1994) and Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA, 2001) followed its framework.
qe: Which National Policy on Education introduced 'Operation Blackboard' (1987) for primary schools and 'Navodaya Vidyalayas' for talented rural children?

q: "शिक्षा बिना बोझ के" (Learning Without Burden, 1993) शीर्षक वाली प्रसिद्ध रिपोर्ट, जिसने राष्ट्रीय पाठ्यचर्या की रूपरेखा (NCF) 2005 को गहराई से प्रभावित किया, किसकी अध्यक्षता वाली समिति द्वारा तैयार की गई थी?
e: The National Advisory Committee chaired by Prof. Yash Pal submitted the landmark report "Learning Without Burden" in July 1993 to address curriculum overload and rote learning; Prof. Yash Pal also chaired the National Steering Committee for NCF 2005. (प्रो. यशपाल की अध्यक्षता वाली समिति ने 1993 में "शिक्षा बिना बोझ के" रिपोर्ट दी तथा वे NCF 2005 की राष्ट्रीय संचालन समिति के भी अध्यक्ष थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Prof. Yash Pal also chaired the 2009 Committee on Renovation and Rejuvenation of Higher Education (recommending a single regulator NCHER); (2) NCF 2005 was the fourth National Curriculum Framework published by NCERT (earlier ones: 1975, 1988, 2000); (3) NCF 2005 is grounded in Constructivism (रचनावाद) and connects school knowledge to life outside school; (4) Prof. Krishna Kumar was the Director of NCERT during NCF 2005.
qe: The famous report titled "Learning Without Burden" (1993), which deeply influenced the National Curriculum Framework (NCF) 2005, was authored by a committee chaired by:

q:
स्वतंत्रता-पूर्व भारत के निम्नलिखित शैक्षिक विकासों को सही कालानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
1. हंटर शिक्षा आयोग
2. वुड का घोषणापत्र
3. सार्जेंट शिक्षा योजना
4. वर्धा बुनियादी शिक्षा योजना
e: Exact chronological order: Wood's Despatch (1854) → Hunter Education Commission (1882) → Wardha Scheme of Basic Education (1937) → Sargent Plan of Education (1944). Hence 2, 1, 4, 3. (सही कालानुक्रम: वुड डिस्पैच (1854) → हंटर आयोग (1882) → वर्धा योजना (1937) → सार्जेंट योजना (1944), अतः 2, 1, 4, 3।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Hunter Commission (1882) was appointed by Lord Ripon and focused on primary and secondary education (splitting high school into literary and vocational streams); (2) Sargent Plan (1944) was prepared by Sir John Sargent, Educational Adviser to the Government of India, under CABE; (3) Abbot-Wood Report (1937) preceded Wardha and dealt with vocational education and polytechnics; (4) First Indian Education Commission was Hunter Commission (1882), while first of Independent India was Radhakrishnan (1948).
qe:
Arrange the following pre-independence educational developments in India in correct chronological order:
1. Hunter Education Commission
2. Wood's Despatch
3. Sargent Plan of Education
4. Wardha Scheme of Basic Education

q:
राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NPE) 1968 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह कोठारी आयोग (1964–66) की सिफारिशों पर आधारित भारत की पहली व्यापक राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति थी।
कथन II: इसने देश भर में माध्यमिक शिक्षा के लिए 'त्रि-भाषा सूत्र' (Three-Language Formula) को औपचारिक रूप से अपनाया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
कथन I और कथन II दोनों
e: Both statements are correct. NPE 1968 (during PM Indira Gandhi's tenure) was based on the Kothari Commission report and formally adopted the Three-Language Formula (Hindi, English, and a modern Indian language—preferably a South Indian language—in Hindi-speaking states; regional language, Hindi, and English in non-Hindi states). (दोनों कथन सही हैं; NPE 1968 कोठारी आयोग पर आधारित प्रथम राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति थी और इसने त्रि-भाषा सूत्र को औपचारिक रूप से अपनाया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NPE 1968 committed to gradually raising education expenditure to 6% of National Income; (2) It also promoted science education, research, and equalization of educational opportunity; (3) The Three-Language Formula was originally proposed by CABE (1956) and modified by Kothari Commission (1964–66); (4) NEP 2020 retains the Three-Language Formula with greater flexibility and no language imposition on any state.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Policy on Education (NPE) 1968:
Statement I: It was India's first comprehensive National Policy on Education, formulated on the recommendations of the Kothari Commission (1964–66).
Statement II: It formally adopted the 'Three-Language Formula' for secondary education across the country.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी समिति/आयोग अपने मुख्य कार्यक्षेत्र से सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: हार्टोग समिति (1929) — प्राथमिक शिक्षा में अपव्यय एवं अवरोधन
न्यायमूर्ति जे.एस. वर्मा आयोग (2012) — शिक्षक शिक्षा में सुधार
आचार्य राममूर्ति समिति (1990) — राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 1986 की समीक्षा
टी.एस.आर. सुब्रमण्यन समिति (2016) — RTE के 25% कोटे का क्रियान्वयन
e: The T.S.R. Subramanian Committee (2016) was constituted to evolve the New Education Policy (it submitted "Evolution of the New Education Policy" in May 2016), NOT specifically for RTE 25% quota. All other three pairs are accurately matched. (टी.एस.आर. सुब्रमण्यन समिति (2016) नई शिक्षा नीति के विकास हेतु गठित की गई थी, न कि RTE 25% कोटे के लिए; अन्य तीनों युग्म सही हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) After T.S.R. Subramanian Committee (2016), the Dr. K. Kasturirangan Committee (2017–19) drafted the final National Education Policy (NEP) 2020; (2) Justice J.S. Verma Commission (2012) led to NCTE Regulations 2014 extending B.Ed. and M.Ed. duration from 1 year to 2 years; (3) Acharya Ramamurti Committee (1990) report was titled "Towards an Enlightened and Humane Society"; (4) Sri Prakasa Committee (1959) focused on Religious and Moral Instruction.
qe: Which of the following committees/commissions is NOT correctly matched with its primary focus area?
oe: Hartog Committee (1929) — Wastage and stagnation in primary education
Justice J.S. Verma Commission (2012) — Reforms in Teacher Education
Acharya Ramamurti Committee (1990) — Review of NPE 1986
T.S.R. Subramanian Committee (2016) — Implementation of RTE 25% quota

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 द्वारा 10+2 प्रणाली के स्थान पर स्कूली शिक्षा की कौन-सी नई पाठ्यचर्या एवं शिक्षण संरचना प्रस्तुत की गई है?
e: NEP 2020 (approved by the Union Cabinet on 29 July 2020) replaces the 10+2 structure with the 5+3+3+4 design covering ages 3 to 18: Foundational (5 yrs: 3 yrs Anganwadi/Balvatika + Grades 1–2), Preparatory (3 yrs: Grades 3–5), Middle (3 yrs: Grades 6–8), and Secondary (4 yrs: Grades 9–12). (NEP 2020 में 3 से 18 वर्ष के लिए 5+3+3+4 संरचना अपनाई गई है: फाउंडेशनल-5, प्रिपरेटरी-3, मिडिल-3 और सेकेंडरी-4 वर्ष।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NEP 2020 was drafted by the 9-member committee chaired by Dr. K. Kasturirangan; (2) It renamed the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) back to the Ministry of Education (MoE); (3) It aims for 100% Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in school education by 2030; (4) Vocational education with internships begins from Grade 6.
qe: What is the new curricular and pedagogical structure of school education introduced by the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 replacing the 10+2 system?

q: NEP 2020 द्वारा वर्ष 2035 तक उच्च शिक्षा (व्यावसायिक शिक्षा सहित) में सकल नामांकन अनुपात (GER) का कितना लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया गया है?
e: NEP 2020 aims to raise the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in Higher Education from 26.3% (2018) to 50% by 2035, adding 3.5 crore new seats. (NEP 2020 में वर्ष 2035 तक उच्च शिक्षा में GER को 26.3% से बढ़ाकर 50% करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) For school education (Pre-school to Secondary), the GER target is 100% by 2030; (2) NEP 2020 reiterates the goal of increasing public investment in education to 6% of GDP; (3) Multi-disciplinary Education and Research Universities (MERUs) will be set up at par with IITs/IIMs; (4) By 2030, the minimum degree qualification for teaching will be a 4-year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP / Integrated B.Ed.).
qe: What is the target Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in Higher Education (including vocational education) set by NEP 2020 to be achieved by 2035?

q: NEP 2020 के अंतर्गत (5 जुलाई 2021 को प्रारंभ) 'निपुण भारत मिशन' का लक्ष्य भारत के प्रत्येक बच्चे को किस कक्षा के अंत तक बुनियादी साक्षरता और संख्यात्मकता (FLN) प्राप्त कराना है?
e: NIPUN Bharat (National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy) targets universal Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) for every child by the end of Grade 3 (ages 3–9) by 2026–27. (निपुण भारत मिशन का उद्देश्य कक्षा 3 के अंत तक प्रत्येक बच्चे में बुनियादी साक्षरता और संख्यात्मकता (FLN) सुनिश्चित करना है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NIPUN Bharat was launched under the centrally sponsored Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan; (2) NEP 2020 treats FLN as the "highest priority" of the education system (initially targeted for 2025, extended in NIPUN implementation to 2026–27); (3) NCF for the Foundational Stage (NCF-FS) 2022 was released on 20 October 2022 alongside 'Jadui Pitara' (play-based learning kit); (4) 'Vidya Pravesh' is a 3-month play-based school preparation module for Grade 1 entrants.
qe: Under NEP 2020, the 'NIPUN Bharat Mission' (launched on 5 July 2021) aims to ensure that every child in India achieves Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) by the end of which grade?

q: NEP 2020 में NCERT के अंतर्गत स्थापित राष्ट्रीय मूल्यांकन केंद्र 'PARAKH' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development
Programme for Assessment, Research, and Analysis of Knowledge in Higher Education
National Portal for Academic Review and Assessment of Knowledge Hierarchy
Pedagogy, Assessment, Review, and Accreditation of Knowledge Hubs
e: PARAKH stands for "Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development", set up as a standard-setting body for all recognized school boards in India. (PARAKH का पूर्ण रूप Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development है, जो सभी स्कूल बोर्डों के मूल्यांकन मानक तय करता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) PARAKH guides State Achievement Surveys (SAS) and conducts the National Achievement Survey (NAS / PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan); (2) It promotes 360-degree Holistic Progress Cards (HPC) replacing rote-based report cards; (3) NEP 2020 mandates school examinations in Grades 3, 5, and 8 to test core competencies; (4) Board exams in Grades 10 and 12 are to be redesigned to test core concepts and allow up to two attempts.
qe: In NEP 2020, what is the full form of 'PARAKH', the National Assessment Centre established within NCERT?
oe: Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development
Programme for Assessment, Research, and Analysis of Knowledge in Higher Education
National Portal for Academic Review and Assessment of Knowledge Hierarchy
Pedagogy, Assessment, Review, and Accreditation of Knowledge Hubs

q: NEP 2020 के अंतर्गत प्रस्तावित भारतीय उच्चतर शिक्षा आयोग (HECI) किन दो क्षेत्रों को छोड़कर शेष संपूर्ण उच्च शिक्षा के लिए एकल नियामक संस्था के रूप में कार्य करेगा?
e: NEP 2020 proposes HECI as a single umbrella regulator for all higher education EXCLUDING Medical Education (regulated by NMC) and Legal Education (regulated by Bar Council of India). (HECI चिकित्सा शिक्षा (NMC) और विधि शिक्षा (BCI) को छोड़कर शेष संपूर्ण उच्च शिक्षा के लिए एकल नियामक होगा।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) HECI will have 4 independent verticals: NHERC (Regulation), NAC (Accreditation), HEGC (Funding/Grants), and GEC (Academic Standards); (2) HECI follows the principle of "Light but Tight" regulation; (3) Existing bodies like UGC, AICTE, and NCTE are proposed to be subsumed/transformed under HECI's verticals; (4) Public and private higher educational institutions will be governed by the same norms.
qe: Under NEP 2020, the proposed Higher Education Commission of India (HECI) will function as a single overarching umbrella body for higher education EXCEPT which two domains?

q: NEP 2020 के अंतर्गत उच्च शिक्षा में प्रारंभ किए गए 'एकेडमिक बैंक ऑफ क्रेडिट्स (ABC)' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: कॉलेज छात्रों को ब्याज-मुक्त शिक्षा ऋण देना
मान्यता प्राप्त उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों से अर्जित शैक्षणिक क्रेडिट को डिजिटल रूप में संग्रहीत कर बहु-प्रवेश व निकास सक्षम करना
भारतीय विश्वविद्यालयों की वैश्विक रैंकिंग करना
e: The Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) digitally stores academic credits earned by students from various recognized Higher Educational Institutions (HEIs) so they can transfer credits and avail Multiple Entry and Exit (Certificate after 1 yr, Diploma after 2 yrs, Degree after 3 yrs, Honours/Research Degree after 4 yrs). (ABC विभिन्न मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों से अर्जित क्रेडिट को डिजिटल रूप में सहेजता है, जिससे 1 वर्ष में सर्टिफिकेट, 2 वर्ष में डिप्लोमा, 3 वर्ष में डिग्री व 4 वर्ष में ऑनर्स डिग्री संभव होती है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) ABC was launched in July 2021 by UGC and integrated with DigiLocker and APAAR ID ("One Nation, One Student ID"); (2) Credits stored in ABC remain valid for a maximum of 7 years; (3) NEP 2020 also discontinued the M.Phil. programme; (4) National Credit Framework (NCrF) integrates school, higher, and vocational education credits.
qe: What is the purpose of the 'Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)' introduced under NEP 2020 in higher education?
oe: Providing zero-interest education loans to college students
Digitally storing academic credits earned from recognized HEIs to enable multiple entry and exit

q: अगस्त 2023 में शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने NEP 2020 पर आधारित स्कूली शिक्षा के लिए राष्ट्रीय पाठ्यचर्या की रूपरेखा (NCF-SE 2023) जारी की। NCF-FS 2022 और NCF-SE 2023 तैयार करने वाली राष्ट्रीय संचालन समिति के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: Former ISRO Chairman Dr. K. Kasturirangan chaired both the NEP 2020 Drafting Committee and the 12-member National Steering Committee (constituted in September 2021) that formulated NCF-FS 2022 and NCF-SE 2023. (पूर्व इसरो अध्यक्ष डॉ. के. कस्तूरीरंगन ने NEP 2020 मसौदा समिति के साथ-साथ NCF-FS 2022 व NCF-SE 2023 हेतु राष्ट्रीय संचालन समिति की भी अध्यक्षता की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NCF-SE 2023 mandates studying 3 languages (at least 2 native Indian languages) up to Grade 10 and 2 languages (at least 1 native Indian) in Grades 11–12; (2) It removes rigid separation between Arts, Commerce, and Science streams in Grades 11–12; (3) NCF-FS 2022 uses the ancient Indian 'Panchakosha' (पञ्चकोश) concept for holistic child development; (4) Four NCFs are envisaged under NEP 2020: NCF-ECCE/FS, NCF-SE, NCF-TE (Teacher Education), and NCF-AE (Adult Education).
qe: In August 2023, the Ministry of Education released the National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE 2023) based on NEP 2020. Who chaired the National Steering Committee that developed NCF-FS 2022 and NCF-SE 2023?

q:
सूची-I (NEP 2020 के तहत HECI का स्तंभ) को सूची-II (मुख्य कार्य) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) NHERC, (2) NAC, (3) HEGC, (4) GEC
सूची-II: (a) प्रत्यायन (Accreditation), (b) शैक्षणिक मानक, (c) विनियमन (Regulation), (d) वित्तपोषण एवं अनुदान
e: Under HECI: NHERC (National Higher Education Regulatory Council) handles Regulation (1-c); NAC (National Accreditation Council) handles Accreditation (2-a); HEGC (Higher Education Grants Council) handles Funding/Grants (3-d); GEC (General Education Council) frames Academic Standards / NHEQF (4-b). (NHERC-विनियमन, NAC-प्रत्यायन, HEGC-वित्तपोषण, GEC-शैक्षणिक मानक; अतः सही कूट 1-c, 2-a, 3-d, 4-b है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NEP 2020 emphasizes complete separation of regulation, accreditation, funding, and standard-setting to eliminate conflict of interest; (2) GEC will formulate the National Higher Education Qualification Framework (NHEQF); (3) Existing professional councils like ICAR, VCI, NCTE, COA, and NCVET will act as Professional Standard Setting Bodies (PSSBs) under GEC; (4) Affiliation system for colleges is to be phased out over 15 years (by 2035) via graded autonomy.
qe:
Match List-I (HECI Vertical under NEP 2020) with List-II (Primary Function) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) NHERC, (2) NAC, (3) HEGC, (4) GEC
List-II: (a) Accreditation, (b) Academic Standards, (c) Regulation, (d) Funding and Grants

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: यह गुणवत्तापूर्ण शोध को बढ़ावा देने हेतु राष्ट्रीय अनुसंधान फाउंडेशन (NRF) की स्थापना का प्रस्ताव करता है
यह जेंडर इनक्लूजन फंड और विशेष शिक्षा क्षेत्रों (SEZs) की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है
यह कक्षा 6 से आगे अंग्रेजी को एकमात्र अनिवार्य शिक्षण माध्यम बनाता है
यह राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक प्रौद्योगिकी मंच (NETF) के गठन की अनुशंसा करता है
e: Statement C is NOT correct. NEP 2020 promotes mother tongue/local/regional language as the medium of instruction wherever possible at least until Grade 5, and preferably till Grade 8 and beyond—it does NOT make English compulsory as the sole medium from Grade 6. (कथन C गलत है; NEP 2020 कम से कम कक्षा 5 और यथासंभव कक्षा 8 व उसके बाद भी मातृभाषा/स्थानीय भाषा में शिक्षण पर बल देती है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Parliament enacted the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) Act, 2023 based on NEP 2020's NRF proposal; (2) Gender Inclusion Fund supports equitable quality education for girls and transgender students; (3) NEP 2020 also mandates 50 hours of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) per year for every teacher; (4) National Professional Standards for Teachers (NPST) are developed by NCTE.
qe: Which of the following statements regarding NEP 2020 is NOT correct?
oe: It proposes setting up a National Research Foundation (NRF) to catalyze quality academic research
It mandates establishing a Gender Inclusion Fund and Special Education Zones (SEZs)
It makes English compulsory as the sole medium of instruction from Grade 6 onwards
It recommends creating a National Educational Technology Forum (NETF)

q: विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) संसद के अधिनियम द्वारा किस वर्ष भारत सरकार का एक वैधानिक निकाय (statutory body) बना?
e: Although formally inaugurated by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad on 28 December 1953, the UGC became a statutory body in November 1956 under the UGC Act, 1956. (यद्यपि UGC का औपचारिक उद्घाटन 28 दिसंबर 1953 को हुआ, यह UGC अधिनियम, 1956 द्वारा नवंबर 1956 में वैधानिक निकाय बना।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) UGC was established on the recommendation of the Radhakrishnan Commission (1948–49); (2) Its headquarters is in New Delhi with 6 regional offices (Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bhopal, Guwahati, Bengaluru); (3) Section 12 of the UGC Act empowers it to coordinate and determine university standards and disburse grants; (4) Its first Chairman was Dr. Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar (1953–55) and first Chairman after statutory status was C.D. Deshmukh (1956–61).
qe: The University Grants Commission (UGC) became a statutory body of the Government of India by an Act of Parliament in which year?

q: राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान और प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCERT) की स्थापना एक स्वायत्त संगठन के रूप में किस वर्ष की गई थी?
e: NCERT was established on 1 September 1961 (registered on 27 July 1961 under the Societies Registration Act) by merging seven existing national institutions, with headquarters in New Delhi. (NCERT की स्थापना 1 सितंबर 1961 को नई दिल्ली में एक स्वायत्त सोसायटी के रूप में की गई थी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NCERT is NOT a statutory body—it is an autonomous registered society; (2) Its constituent units include NIE (New Delhi), CIET (New Delhi), PSSCIVE (Bhopal), and 5 Regional Institutes of Education (RIEs: Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru, Shillong); (3) In September 2023, NCERT was granted 'Deemed-to-be-University' status under the 'De novo' category; (4) Its motto is "विद्ययाऽमृतमश्नुते" (Life eternal through learning), taken from the Isha Upanishad.
qe: In which year was the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) established as an autonomous organization?

q: राष्ट्रीय अध्यापक शिक्षा परिषद (NCTE), जो शिक्षक शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों और न्यूनतम शिक्षक योग्यताओं (जैसे TET) को विनियमित करती है, को संसद के किस अधिनियम द्वारा वैधानिक दर्जा मिला?
e: Originally set up as an advisory body in 1973, NCTE became a statutory body under the National Council for Teacher Education Act, 1993 (No. 73 of 1993) and formally came into existence in its statutory form on 17 August 1995. (1973 में सलाहकार निकाय के रूप में स्थापित NCTE को राष्ट्रीय अध्यापक शिक्षा परिषद अधिनियम, 1993 द्वारा 17 अगस्त 1995 को वैधानिक दर्जा प्राप्त हुआ।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NCTE headquarters is in New Delhi with 4 Regional Committees (Eastern, Western, Northern, Southern); (2) Under Section 23(1) of the RTE Act, 2009, NCTE is the academic authority that laid down minimum qualifications for Classes I–VIII teachers, including passing TET (Notification dated 23 August 2010); (3) TET certificate validity was extended from 7 years to LIFETIME in June 2021; (4) NCTE is implementing the 4-year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) under NEP 2020.
qe: The National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE), which regulates teacher education programmes and minimum teacher qualifications (like TET), attained statutory status under which Act of Parliament?

q: उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों के मूल्यांकन और प्रत्यायन हेतु 1994 में UGC द्वारा स्थापित स्वायत्त संस्था राष्ट्रीय मूल्यांकन एवं प्रत्यायन परिषद (NAAC) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: NAAC was established in September 1994 as an autonomous institution of the UGC following the recommendations of NPE 1986 and POA 1992, with its headquarters in Bengaluru (Karnataka). (NPE 1986 व POA 1992 की सिफारिश पर सितंबर 1994 में स्थापित NAAC का मुख्यालय बेंगलुरु में स्थित है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NAAC grades institutions on a CGPA scale (from A++ down to C, or Binary Accreditation under recent 2024 reforms based on Dr. K. Radhakrishnan Committee); (2) NBA (National Board of Accreditation), established in 1994 by AICTE, accredits technical programmes (headquartered in New Delhi); (3) AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) was set up in 1945 as an advisory body and became statutory under the AICTE Act, 1987; (4) NIEPA (National Institute of Educational Planning and Administration), New Delhi, is a deemed university specializing in educational planning.
qe: The National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), an autonomous body established by the UGC in 1994 to assess and accredit higher educational institutions, has its headquarters in which city?

q: राज्य शैक्षिक अनुसंधान और प्रशिक्षण परिषद (SCERT), उत्तर प्रदेश की स्थापना लखनऊ में किस वर्ष की गई थी?
e: SCERT Uttar Pradesh was established in 1981 in Lucknow to develop school curricula, textbooks, and teacher training across UP. (उत्तर प्रदेश में स्कूली पाठ्यचर्या, पाठ्यपुस्तक विकास और शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण हेतु SCERT उत्तर प्रदेश की स्थापना 1981 में लखनऊ में हुई।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Key units under SCERT UP include SIEMAT (Prayagraj), Examination Regulatory Authority / PNP (Prayagraj), State Institute of Science Education (Prayagraj), and English Language Teaching Institute (Prayagraj); (2) All 75 districts of UP have DIETs (District Institutes of Education and Training) academically guided by SCERT UP; (3) UP Basic Education Act was enacted in 1972 establishing the Uttar Pradesh Basic Education Board (UPBEB); (4) UP Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UP Board), established in 1921 at Prayagraj, is the world's largest school examination board by candidate volume.
qe: In which year was the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT), Uttar Pradesh established in Lucknow?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश शिक्षा सेवा चयन आयोग (UPESSC) अधिनियम, 2023 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इस आयोग का मुख्यालय प्रयागराज में है और यह उत्तर प्रदेश में बेसिक, माध्यमिक, उच्च एवं सहायता प्राप्त संस्थानों में शिक्षक भर्ती को एकीकृत करता है।
कथन II: यह पूर्ववर्ती उत्तर प्रदेश माध्यमिक शिक्षा सेवा चयन बोर्ड (UPSESSB) और उत्तर प्रदेश उच्चतर शिक्षा सेवा आयोग (UPHESC) का स्थान लेता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: कथन I और कथन II दोनों
न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
e: Both statements are correct. The UPESSC Act, 2023 (passed in August 2023, Rules notified in December 2023) created a unified teacher recruitment commission headquartered at Prayagraj, subsuming UPSESSB (1982) and UPHESC (1980). (दोनों कथन सही हैं; UPESSC अधिनियम, 2023 ने प्रयागराज मुख्यालय के साथ एकीकृत शिक्षक चयन आयोग गठित किया जिसने UPSESSB और UPHESC का स्थान लिया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) UPESSC comprises 1 Chairperson and 12 Members appointed by the State Government for a term of 3 years or up to age 65 (whichever is earlier); (2) It conducts UPTET, Basic Assistant Teacher, TGT/PGT, and Assistant Professor recruitments; (3) Prof. Kirti Pandey was appointed the first regular Chairperson of UPESSC in September 2024; (4) Earlier, UPSESSB was governed by the 1982 Act and UPHESC by the 1980 Act.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) Act, 2023:
Statement I: The Commission is headquartered in Prayagraj and consolidates teacher recruitment for Basic, Secondary, Higher, and Aided Minority/Technical institutions in Uttar Pradesh.
Statement II: It replaces the earlier Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Services Selection Board (UPSESSB) and the Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Services Commission (UPHESC).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q:
सूची-I (शैक्षिक संस्थान/निकाय) को सूची-II (वैधानिक दर्जा / स्थापना वर्ष) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) UGC (वैधानिक अधिनियम), (2) AICTE (वैधानिक अधिनियम), (3) NCTE (वैधानिक अधिनियम), (4) CBSE (केंद्रीय बोर्ड के रूप में पुनर्गठन)
सूची-II: (a) 1987, (b) 1956, (c) 1962, (d) 1993
e: UGC Act was enacted in 1956 (1-b); AICTE Act was enacted in 1987 (2-a); NCTE Act was enacted in 1993 (3-d); CBSE was reconstituted in its present form as the Central Board of Secondary Education on 1 July 1962 (4-c). (UGC अधिनियम-1956, AICTE अधिनियम-1987, NCTE अधिनियम-1993, CBSE पुनर्गठन-1962; अतः सही कूट 1-b, 2-a, 3-d, 4-c है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) CBSE traces its origins to the Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana (1929), and was reconstituted in 1962; (2) NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) was established in November 1989 (as NOS, renamed NIOS in 2002); (3) IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University) was established by an Act of Parliament in 1985; (4) NTA (National Testing Agency) was established in November 2017 as an autonomous registered society.
qe:
Match List-I (Educational Institution/Body) with List-II (Year of Statutory Status / Establishment) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) UGC (Statutory Act), (2) AICTE (Statutory Act), (3) NCTE (Statutory Act), (4) CBSE (Reconstituted as Central Board)
List-II: (a) 1987, (b) 1956, (c) 1962, (d) 1993
